packages.angle: Bitcoin's real value is structural, but the crowd only trades on sentiment.

segments.label: hook
segments.text: When Bitcoin and an asset is going up and the bull market is super hot, everyone loves it. When the bear market is happening and Bitcoin is going down, everyone hates it. And like, that's why the price got high and that's why the price got low, because everyone loved it at the top and everyone wanted exposure and everyone hated it and didn't want exposure at the bottom.

segments.label: clip_01
segments.text: Bitcoin shows you that you can just increase the purchasing power. So the value of Bitcoin goes up without the supply of Bitcoin going up. So the people who hold Bitcoin don't get robbed.

segments.label: clip_02
segments.text: Now, higher rates make cash more attractive and borrowed money more expensive, which is very much the wrong combo for anything risky, and the market definitely sees Bitcoin as risky.
